description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Reflex builds, deploys, and manages production applications in Python. The Software Engineer builds and maintains shared platform technology across infrastructure, AI, and the open-source Reflex framework, from design and implementation through release and production operation.
Software Engineer building Reflex components, APIs, application runtimes, shared AI integrations, and hosting/deployment infrastructure

Responsibilities:
• Design, implement, test, review, and release maintainable software. Explain technical tradeoffs and document interfaces and operational behavior
• Build and operate hosting, deployment systems, monitoring, and recovery tooling. Improve reliability, capacity, infrastructure security, and cost, including on-premises platform deployments where applicable
• Build shared AI capabilities and model integrations. Improve inference performance, latency, and cost; develop evaluations and investigate quality regressions and production failures
• Develop core Reflex components, APIs, and application runtime capabilities. Fix framework defects, improve performance and developer experience, and maintain compatibility, releases, and migration guidance
• Maintain meaningful tests, diagnostics, and documentation. Diagnose incidents and address recurring failure modes
• Collaborate with Platform engineers and Forward Deployed Engineers on shared dependencies. Work with the Deployment Strategist to understand customer feedback and shape reusable product improvements

Requirements:
• Strong software engineering skills and experience building production systems
• Ability to design, debug, test, and maintain reliable software
• Clear communication of technical decisions and tradeoffs
• Relevant depth in infrastructure, AI systems, or frameworks and developer tools
• Helpful experience includes Python, cloud infrastructure, deployment automation, model APIs and evaluations, application runtimes, frontend integration, and open-source development. Specialized experience depends on the project
• Must be authorized to work in the United States
• Reflex does not offer visa sponsorship for this role
